correctness.rationale: The block inverse identity gives the Nyström conditional covariance as \(A_{TT}^{-1}\), and Jacobi gives \(\det K_{SS}=\det A_{TT}/\det A\); the complement decomposes into tridiagonal path blocks. The continuant hyperbolic formula makes \(F'_m/F_m\) strictly discretely convex and \(\log F_m\) strictly concave for every positive screening parameter. Strict gap smoothing proves all optimizers, values, ties and runner-up compositions. The Wronskian \(F_m^2-F_{m-1}F_{m+1}=1\) proves the exact second-best ratio. A separate standard-library rational checker executed 8,695 checks, including direct covariance reconstructions. Computations support but do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A motivated complete optimization problem for structured low-rank approximation and Gaussian sensor design, covering every finite ring size, budget, positive screening shift, all labelled equality sets, explicit values and a sharp second-best loss for exact divisibility. Simultaneous A-type trace and D-type entropy optimality is nontrivial and not general for other Gaussian processes. The nonnesting example gives a concrete consequence for sequential landmark policies; value does not depend on a general algorithmic lower bound.
